name: timestamp
description: Metric timestamp, from the Sparkplug payload/metric timestamp (ms since epoch).

name: device_id
description: Sparkplug Device ID. Null for node-level metrics (e.g. bdSeq, Node Control/Rebirth).

name: metric_name
description: Metric name, resolved from the BIRTH-message alias table if the source message only carried an alias.

name: alias
description: Sparkplug metric alias, if present on the source message.

name: value_int64
description: Populated for Int8/16/32/64 and UInt8/16/32/64 metrics.

name: seq
description: Sparkplug node-level sequence number (0-255) carried on this message's payload.

name: bd_seq
description: The Edge Node's birth/death sequence number in effect when this message was published, identifying its MQTT session.

name: ingestion_time
description: When the consumer wrote this row, for lag/freshness monitoring.
